snippet.title: Reytrieve Odyssey - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Reytrieve Odyssey is a vibrant 3D platformer starring a feisty android girl on a quest to retrieve mysterious data disks! Switch between powerful cartridges, explore giant colorful islands, and uncover the secrets of a broken world! 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3798840/Reytrieve_Odyssey/?curator_clanid=4777282

Developer: EgorPosk
X: https://x.com/Egor_Poskriakov

#indiegame #adventure #platformer
